function.name: resolve_membership
function.description: Check demo membership for the saved person and confirmed service location. Uses saved name, street, unit and ZIP; server binds call identity. Call only after saving required facts and explicit address confirmation, never before emergency/priority handling. No account authentication, phone linking, benefits or booking. Use current revision; unresolved or failed is unknown, not nonmember.
